mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_header(reservation_no,order_no,quote_no,request_hash,status,decision,expires_at,reject_reason) VALUES(#{reservationNo},#{orderNo},#{quoteNo},#{requestHash},#{status},#{decision},#{expiresAt},#{rejectReason}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_no,order_no,quote_no,request_hash,status,decision,reject_reason FROM reservation_header WHERE reservation_no=#{reservationNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT merchant_id FROM product_quote WHERE quote_no=#{quoteNo}
SELECT quote_no,user_id,source_order_no,bound_order_no,status,(expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) valid FROM product_quote WHERE quote_no=#{quoteNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT CAST(sku_id AS CHAR) sku_id,quantity FROM quote_item WHERE quote_no=#{quoteNo} ORDER BY sku_id
SELECT CAST(sku_id AS CHAR) sku_id,quantity FROM reservation_item WHERE reservation_no=#{reservationNo} ORDER BY sku_id
mapper.update: UPDATE product_quote SET bound_order_no=#{boundOrderNo},status='BOUND',version=version+1 WHERE quote_no=#{quoteNo} AND ((status='VALID' AND bound_order_no IS NULL) OR (status='BOUND' AND bound_order_no=#{boundOrderNo}))

UPDATE inventory SET available_qty=available_qty-#{quantity},reserved_qty=reserved_qty+#{quantity},version=version+1 WHERE warehouse_id='warehouse_main' AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND available_qty>=#{quantity}

UPDATE inventory SET available_qty=available_qty+#{quantity},reserved_qty=reserved_qty-#{quantity},version=version+1 WHERE warehouse_id='warehouse_main' AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND reserved_qty>=#{quantity}
UPDATE reservation_header SET status='REJECTED',reject_reason=#{rejectReason},version=version+1 WHERE reservation_no=#{reservationNo} AND status='RESERVED'

UPDATE reservation_header SET status=IF(status='REJECTED','REJECTED','RELEASED'),decision='RELEASE',version=version+1 WHERE reservation_no=#{reservationNo} AND status IN ('RESERVED','REJECTED','RELEASED') AND decision<>'COMMIT'
UPDATE inventory SET reserved_qty=reserved_qty-#{quantity},version=version+1 WHERE warehouse_id='warehouse_main' AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND reserved_qty>=#{quantity}
UPDATE reservation_header SET status='CONFIRMED',decision='COMMIT',version=version+1 WHERE reservation_no=#{reservationNo} AND status='RESERVED' AND decision='UNDECIDED'
